policy: Released-device calibration must include phones released on or before the cutoff date, not merely older historical devices.
Prioritize the newest released generation first, then backfill earlier generations for longitudinal calibration.
Phones announced for a future date after the cutoff remain unreleased priors and must not enter released-device calibration.
A device may enter the released corpus only when its commercial release date or reviewed retail availability is verified.
Re-run the cutoff regularly so the calibration corpus advances with the market.
